fact: Moroccan courts handled 153 cases on personal data protection in 2024 (70 at appeal courts, 83 at first instance), issuing prison sentences and fines, per the delegated president of the Superior Council of the Judiciary at a CNDP event on 2025-01-27.
title: عقوبات وغرامات.. محاكم المغرب تسجل 153 قضية متعلقة بحماية المعطيات الخاصة
